mapper.select: SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER)) AS COM_NAME, --[00] POHD.PO_NO AS PO_NO, --[01] MAX(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, --[02] MAX(POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, --[03] MAX(PODT.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, --[04] MAX(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PODT.RD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD')-2,'YYYYMMDD')) AS GR_DATE_RE, --[05] MAX(DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고' ,'X','Kepmro'||(SELECT DECODE(PRE_GR_FLAG, 'Y', ' 선입고', '') FROM ICOMPRHD WHERE BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND STATUS <> 'D') ,'일반')) AS DOC_TEXT, --[06] MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME) AS ADD_USER_NAME, --[07] MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL) AS ADD_USER_TEL, --[08] MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, --[09] MAX((SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, --[10] MAX(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, --[11] MAX(POHD.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK, --[12] MAX(POHD.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE, --[13] MAX(POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT, --[14] POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, --[15] MAX(DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI')) AS STATUS_TEXT --[16] FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = #{st_BUYER} AND POHD.PO_NO =#{st_PO_NO} AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ GROUP BY POHD.BUYER, POHD.PO_NO
